applyTo: "src/app/**/*.{ts,html}"

# Internationalization guidelines

## Rules

- All user-facing strings must be translatable.
- Do not hardcode visible text in components or templates.
- Follow the repository translation key conventions consistently.
- Keep language-specific content centralized.

## Avoid

- inline user-visible copy in templates
- introducing new hardcoded labels for temporary UI states
